description: This file is a shell script for testing diff/status color escape codes in Git, including functions that generate color escape sequences based on color names, attributes, and RGB values, along with a series of test cases verifying their correctness.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Generates a color escape sequence based on color names or specifications and compares it with actual Git configuration output.

methods.name: invalid_color
methods.description: Checks that an invalid color specification causes a failure in 'git config --get-color'.
